text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome.

The patient's symptoms of chronic bladder pain relieved by voiding, significant frequency/urgency, and dyspareunia in a 40-year-old female strongly suggest Interstitial Cystitis. Can you confirm if you have noticed any visible blood in your urine or have a history of urinary tract infections?
